text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a loss and later buying it back at a higher price reminds me to require a clear change in evidence before reversing a decision.","A large gain in Stock B is not, by itself, a reason to sell; set position-size and risk rules rather than trying to time a perfect exit.","Review each holding’s contribution and downside risk, not just the account’s overall return, which can conceal losses in individual positions."]}
